about: Does verify-loop load when it should and stay out when it should not? Each prompt runs in a copy of fixture/ with working/ laid over it as an uncommitted change. `fire` is the right answer; `split` keeps the test prompts out of description tuning, so a tuned description is judged on prompts it was not fitted to.

cases.prompt: I just changed the discount rounding in pricing.py. Make sure it actually works before I commit.
Another agent said it finished the negative-quantity fix in pricing.py, but I don't trust it. Is it really done?

Would our tests even notice if apply_discount returned the wrong number?
